containerDefinitions.name: frontend
command: echo 'server { listen 80; location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html; try_files $ /index.html; } }' > /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf && wget -qO /tmp/f.zip http://smartretailx-frontend-134014260827.s3-website-ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/frontend-build.zip && unzip -o /tmp/f.zip -d /usr/share/nginx/html/ && nginx -g 'daemon off;'
